name: logo-marquee
title: Logo Marquee
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Infinite logo row that pauses on hover and fades at the edges.

meta.descriptionEs: Carrusel infinito de logos que se pausa al pasar el cursor y se desvanece en los bordes.

examples.title: Carrusel de logos
examples.description: Carrusel infinito de logos que se pausa al pasar el cursor y se desvanece en los bordes.

api.name: children
api.description: Logos. They are duplicated for the loop.

api.name: controls
api.description: Pause and play button. Brand color assets are not included. Adapted from Arc UI (MIT).

docs: The edge fade uses the host foreground token as a mask. The animation stops when the reader prefers reduced motion. No theme is shipped. Adapted behaviors from Arc UI (MIT) are optional and do not change existing props.
